scripts.backend:dev: uv run --project backend uvicorn lifegoods.main:app --app-dir backend/src --reload
scripts.backend:lint: uv run --project backend ruff check backend/src backend/tests backend/scripts
scripts.generated-data:init: uv run --project backend python -m lifegoods.generated_data.cli init
scripts.generated-data:verify: uv run --project backend python -m lifegoods.generated_data.cli verify
scripts.generated-data:status: uv run --project backend python -m lifegoods.generated_data.cli status
scripts.generated-data:quarantine: uv run --project backend python -m lifegoods.generated_data.cli quarantine
scripts.benchmark:run: uv run --project backend python -m lifegoods.translation.benchmark.cli run --mode offline
scripts.benchmark:live: uv run --project backend python -m lifegoods.translation.benchmark.cli run --mode live
scripts.api:generate: uv run --project backend python backend/scripts/export_openapi.py && pnpm --dir frontend api:generate
scripts.api:check: pnpm api:generate && git diff --exit-code -- frontend/openapi.json frontend/src/api/generated
